ref_entities: build a RowSelfAttention module to compute self-attention over rows of a 2D MSA input tensor
build a ColumnSelfAttention module to compute self-attention over columns of a 2D MSA input tensor
run the RowSelfAttention forward pass on a 4D tensor with shape rows, cols, batch, embed_dim
run the ColumnSelfAttention forward pass on a 4D tensor with optional padding mask support
review the RowSelfAttention batched forward method that chunks rows to limit memory usage during inference
create a FastaBatchedDataset from a FASTA file using the from_file class method
get batch indices for sequences in a FastaBatchedDataset based on tokens per batch size
create an ESM Alphabet object from a named architecture like ESM-1 or ESM-1b
convert a raw batch of protein sequence labels and strings into tokenized tensors using BatchConverter
read and parse protein sequences from a FASTA file with optional gap and insertion filtering
build a TransformerLayer with multihead attention, feed-forward network, and pre-layer normalization for ESM protein models
build an AxialTransformerLayer with row and column self-attention blocks for MSA transformer protein models
create a ContactPredictionHead that applies symmetrization and APC to attention weights for protein contact prediction
create a LearnedPositionalEmbedding or SinusoidalPositionalEmbedding module to encode sequence position into protein embeddings
create a RobertaLMHead for masked language modeling that projects features back to vocabulary size with tied weights
create a MultiheadAttention module with embed_dim and num_heads for transformer self-attention
run the MultiheadAttention forward pass with query, key, and value tensors to compute attention output
test the FairseqIncrementalState class to get and set incremental state for cached attention decoding
refactor the upgrade_state_dict_named method to migrate legacy in_proj_weight to separate q, k, v projections
review the with_incremental_state decorator that adds FairseqIncrementalState mixin to a class for state caching
load a pretrained ESM-2 protein language model by name from the FAIR model hub
load a pretrained ESM model and alphabet from a local .pt checkpoint file path
load the ESMFold v1 model for fast atomic-level protein structure prediction from sequence
load the ESM-1b 33-layer 650M parameter best-performing model from the pretrained model hub
load one of the five ESM-1v 33-layer 650M parameter ensemble models trained on UniRef90
create a RotaryEmbedding module with a given dimension for rotary position embeddings
run the forward pass on query and key tensors through a RotaryEmbedding module
apply rotary position embeddings to a tensor using precomputed cos and sin tables
test the rotate_half function that splits and negates half of a tensor's last dimension
review the _update_cos_sin_tables method that caches cosine and sine frequency tables
